{{Quote|Or with the skyboats on Xoman Three when you exposed the traitor and recovered the little princess from the pirates! That was ''awesome!''<nowiki></nowiki>|[[Xiaan Amersu]], to [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]]|<ref name="HoF" />}}
At some point between c. [[38 BBY/Legends|38 BBY]]<ref name="JAS" /><ref name="JCF" /> and [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]],<ref name="Twilight" /><ref name="TCC" /> the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] went on a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Xoman III]]. During their mission, they exposed a traitor and rescued a [[Unidentified princess|young princess]] who had been kidnapped by [[skyboat]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].<ref name="HoF" /><ref name="SW36" /><ref name="FF103" />
